walker.name: Sentinel x MacKenzie Basecamp Walker - Black Dyneema
walker.maker_copy: Many products speak of their evolution, however, the MacKenzie Walker was born fully formed and over the years its evolution is more aptly described as refinement, akin to a sculpture. MacKenzie has taken away all unnecessary elements of the golf bag to fulfill its original purpose: carry your clubs, golf balls, and necessities in an elegant and uncomplicated manner.
walker.maker_copy_dyneema: Dyneema® is an ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) developed in 1969 and backed by groundbreaking engineering making it the world's strongest fiber™. Composite fabrics are created using layers of bio-based Dyneema® fibers specially designed to deliver the required strength, stretch, weight, and minimum thickness. Thanks to its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, Dyneema® allows for the creation of high-performance, ultra-light gear that offers unparalleled reliability and durability as natural byproducts. Bio-based Dyneema® achieves this while also delivering a 90%-lower carbon footprint than generic HMPE fibers and manufactured with 100% renewable sources of energy in its manufacturing process.
walker.maker_note: // MADE TO ORDER // SHIPS IN 6-8 WEEKS. ALL SALES FINAL. NO CUSTOMIZATIONS CAN BE MADE TO THE BASECAMP SERIES BAGS. (White Dyneema listing adds: Please note, these fabrics are not stain-proof.)

hawbuck.name: Hawbuck Lean Wallet, H01, Black, with Dyneema Composite Fabric Hybrid
hawbuck.maker_copy: The Hawbuck Lean™ Wallet: a tough, ultra-thin and ultra-light (5 grams) made with Dyneema® wallet. It's designed to be minimal and practical. It's comfortable because it's so slim—coming it at under a millimeter. This wallet is thin enough that the thickness of your wallet isn't determined so much by the wallet itself, but by how disciplined you are in keeping unnecessary cards out. This design is for those that would rather not carry a wallet. The motive is to make it go away as much as possible.
hawbuck.maker_copy_material: Made with Dyneema® Composite Fabric Hybrid-- a laminate comprised of UHMWPE fibers, films and a woven polyester face cloth for texture and abrasion resistance. There are many outstanding attributes to this material. It won't absorb moisture, so it makes a great cycling wallet—or really any activity where you sweat or get wet. The material also demonstrates extremely low stretch over time. It's a good vegan option.
specs: Fits US, Australian, smaller Singaporean, Argentine bills; euros up to €20
Sewn with polyester thread, thread flame-fused at seam ends
Stamped with alcohol based mil-spec parachute marking ink
Material made in Arizona. Thread made in Germany. Wallet made in USA.

dsptch.name: DSPTCH Zero-1 Bag - RND Edition - Dyneema - Black
dsptch.maker_copy: The Zero-1 Collection is our take on bags and accessories that exhibit more active use cases. Drawing from the concept of "close to zero," each item is designed to feel nearly weightless—minimizing distraction so you can stay focused on the terrain, the ride, or the experience. The Zero-1 Bag is constructed from 5.0 oz Dyneema® Composite Fabric paired with mesh-bonded perforated EVA foam. This material combination offers an optimal balance of structural integrity, impact padding, and airflow.
dsptch.maker_copy_features: The bag features a quick access front mesh gusset pocket and a fold-down magnetic buckle closure into the main compartment. The magnetic buckle adjustments double as a compression strap when the bag is underloaded. The bag also comes equipped with our Zero-1 Bag Sling Strap, which was designed for ergonomic stability and long-duration comfort. Constructed out of a breathable spacer mesh fabric, the sling strap has a built-in Fidlock Snap Buckle Combi stabilizer strap, chest zip pocket, and a quick release & adjust system. The Strap is available in right or left shoulder orientation.
specs: Exterior: 5.0 oz Dyneema Composite Fabric; mesh bonded perforated EVA foam
Lining: 420D Nylon Packcloth Fabric w/ DWR coating
Product type: Packs; tags: rnd-edition, sling
